description: The donut chart, titled "Stimuli Type," illustrates the distribution of various types of stimuli used in the development of story case studies related to generative AI's use in journalism at Agency A. The chart is composed of eight distinct segments, each representing a different stimulus type and its corresponding percentage of total usage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents "Draft/Other" at 28.5%. The second largest is "Press Release," shown in yellow, accounting for 21.9%. Other notable segments include "External News Article" (dark green, 13.1%), "Interview" (blue, 10.2%), and "Organizational Report" and "Event Posting" (both in light purple, 8.8% each). Smaller categories include "Organizational Website" (dark blue, 6.6%), "Social Media Post" (light green, 1.5%), and "Intra-agency news article" (orange, 0.7%). Each segment is labeled with its type and percentage value, and the chart is arranged in a clockwise sequence starting from the top. The central white space contains the title "Stimuli Type," clearly indicating the chart's focus.
